items: 1/2 cup butter or margarine, melted and divided
Combine flour, salt and cayenne in a bag. Add chicken and shake to coat.
Pour 4 Tbsp butter into a 9x13 pan. Place chicken in pan and turn once to coat.
Bake uncovered at 350°F for 30 minutes (15 minutes for chicken breast).
Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake 45 minutes longer or until chicken is tender.
